package imports

import "core:fmt"
import str "core:strings"
import "base:runtime"

foreign import libc "system:c"
foreign import kernel32 {
    "system:kernel32.lib",
    "system:user32.lib",
}

@(default_calling_convention = "c", link_prefix = "SDL_")
foreign libc {
    puts :: proc(s: cstring) -> i32 ---
    @(link_name = "errno") err: i32
}

foreign {
    hidden :: proc() ---
}
